why_ai: On-set lighting of physical products, food and buildings protects much of the work, but packshots and secondary images are being taken by automated rigs, CGI and generative tools, and no licence is required.
why_clarity: Ecommerce briefs are spec-defined and repeat at volume, while advertising and architectural work is judged by taste, with retouching and approvals giving fast partial feedback.
why_digital: Starts from physical products, sites and food on a set and ends as digital files, bought both locally and remotely with samples shipped in.

why_ai: Agencies shortlist a specific photographer for the treatment and the eye, and campaign shoots with talent, props and locations remain physical and high-stakes.
why_clarity: Each campaign is a bespoke creative brief judged by art directors and clients, and whether the images worked shows only in the campaign's results.
why_digital: Products, talent and sets in front of the camera, digital files out, and bids handled remotely though shoots happen in person.

why_ai: Physical samples still need handling and lighting, but per-SKU work is commoditising fast under rigs, CGI and generative secondary images.
why_clarity: Shot lists, brand guides and retailer specs define each image, repeated across thousands of SKUs, with rejections arriving within days.
why_digital: Physical samples are shipped to the studio and shot on set, and images are delivered digitally to brands anywhere.

why_ai: Templated white-background shots are the work automated rigs, CAD-based rendering and generative tools substitute most directly.
why_clarity: Retailer specifications make every image checkable pass or fail, across near-identical SKUs, with ingest rejecting errors at once.
why_digital: A physical sample on a rig is the only non-digital step; everything after is files, specs and uploads.

why_ai: Directing models and holding a brand look keep people on set, though AI model generation and replicas are taking part of the work.
why_clarity: Brand guides codify crops and poses, but consistency is ultimately the creative director's judgement across high-volume seasons.
why_digital: Models, garments and sets in person, digital files out, with production usually local to the studio.

why_ai: Finished buildings must be photographed in person at the right hour, and design firms commission photographers whose eye they trust.
why_clarity: Shot lists and corrected verticals are standard, but light, composition and what flatters the design are judgement calls.
why_digital: Starts from a physical site visit and ends as digital files, with photographers hired regionally.

why_ai: A perishable set built by a stylist and lit against the clock is hands-on, though generative imagery threatens menu and secondary shots.
why_clarity: Approval criteria are partly regulatory and partly taste, styling methods vary by practitioner, and approval comes on the day.
why_digital: Real food on a physical set, captured in person, delivered as files to brands that usually hire locally.

why_ai: Clients hire a known person for on-site work, but the commodity jobs solo photographers rely on are the first exposed to AI and productised studios.
why_clarity: Jobs vary across genres and clients, with informal briefs and no producer defining what done means.
why_digital: Shoots are in person, while quoting, delivery and payment are online and clients are mostly regional.

why_ai: Small sellers buy on price, and generative tools and productised studios substitute directly for most of what they order.
why_clarity: Marketplace specs and templated shot lists repeat across thousands of small orders, with conversion tests giving measurable feedback.
why_digital: Samples are mailed in and everything else is ordered, delivered and paid for online, often across borders.

why_ai: Routine masking, compositing and cleanup are exactly what segmentation models and AI editors now do.
why_clarity: Style guides and retailer specs define each edit, repeated thousands of times a night, with client QA passing or failing quickly.
why_digital: Files in, files out, routinely offshore.

why_ai: Matching uses to licences and drafting demands is automatable, with legal escalation the only protected step.
why_clarity: A use is licensed or it is not, checked across many near-identical cases, though resolution takes weeks to months.
why_digital: Web crawls, contracts and letters handled entirely remotely.

why_ai: Advertisers rely on a named consultant's judgement and independence in award decisions, though rate benchmarking itself automates.
why_clarity: Estimate reviews follow a repeatable method against rate history, but whether a recommendation was right shows only after production.
why_digital: Estimates and documents reviewed on screen, with consultants engaged through advertiser procurement relationships.

why_ai: Matching and first-contact demands automate, while negotiation and legal escalation keep some people; AI-era copying grows the volume.
why_clarity: Each case follows the same pipeline and resolves to a settled fee, refusal or lawsuit within months.
why_digital: Crawled matches, letters and payments handled entirely online across jurisdictions.

why_ai: Licensed attorneys must file and argue claims personally and carry the professional liability.
why_clarity: Infringement claims follow established forms, but outcomes depend on courts and arrive slowly.
why_digital: Filings and evidence are digital, with hearings and client intake partly in person within a jurisdiction.

why_ai: Image scoring is model-driven software that larger platforms and generative tools can replicate.
why_clarity: Scores are produced at scale by a defined model, but validation against sales is partial and delayed.
why_digital: Images in, scores and reports out, sold online to brands anywhere.

why_ai: Analyst credibility with manufacturers carries some weight, but surveys and sizing are analysis AI tools increasingly produce.
why_clarity: Recurring trackers follow fixed methods, while forecasts are checked only when the market arrives.
why_digital: Survey and shipment data analysed and delivered as digital reports.

why_ai: Producers run physical shoots and negotiate on relationships, while estimate drafting is increasingly automatable.
why_clarity: Estimates follow a standard structure, but usage pricing is judgement and outcomes are known only on award.
why_digital: Estimates are digital, productions are physical, and clients are reached nationally.

why_ai: Standardised product shoots sold online are the work generative tools and automation substitute most directly.
why_clarity: Templated shoots repeat across many thousands of orders with clear specs and quick acceptance.
why_digital: Samples shipped in, everything else ordered and delivered online.

why_ai: Global brands value the networks' scale and relationships, but adaptation and routine production are being automated hardest.
why_clarity: Asset adaptation follows brand rules at high volume, with campaign-level outcomes slower to judge.
why_digital: Mostly digital production hubs serving global clients, with some physical shoots.

why_ai: Workflow and capture software is itself the automation, and its research is screen work.
why_clarity: Throughput, reshoots and approval times are measured continuously across customers.
why_digital: Delivered as software and telemetry worldwide.

why_ai: Internal market research is analysis increasingly assisted by AI, with product bets the protected part.
why_clarity: Research informs product decisions whose results show in sales years later.
why_digital: Surveys, registrations and telemetry analysed on screen, with some in-person pro events.

why_ai: Representation is a relationship business with art buyers that AI does not replace.
why_clarity: Each negotiation is bespoke and success shows only in awards and repeat bookings.
why_digital: Portfolios and bids are digital, relationships partly in person.

why_ai: Physical sample handling keeps staff on set, but templated in-house production is a prime target for rigs and generation.
why_clarity: Shot lists and specs define every image across thousands of SKUs a day, checked at ingest.
why_digital: Physical samples shot in-house, digital images published to the company's own channels.

why_ai: Commodity editing at per-image prices is directly substituted by AI editing tools.
why_clarity: Defined edits at enormous volume with immediate client QA.
why_digital: Files exchanged entirely online, typically offshore.

why_ai: Member trust and copyright advocacy persist, though guides and surveys are easy to replicate.
why_clarity: Surveys and templates follow repeatable methods but are interpreted loosely.
why_digital: Publications and member services delivered online, with chapter events in person.

why_ai: Licensed underwriters and claims handlers carry accountability, though small-business lines are increasingly automated.
why_clarity: Underwriting rules are codified, but claims outcomes arrive slowly.
why_digital: Policies quoted, bound and serviced online, largely through programmes.
